section1.title: 1. About Turiva
section1.body: Turiva is an intermediation platform that connects tourists to local operators of tours and transfers in Jericoacoara and the surrounding area (Preá, Jijoca, Lagoa do Paraíso and nearby areas). The services are carried out by registered partner operators and operators.

section2.title: 2. Registration and account
section2.body: To make a booking, you must create an account with true and up-to-date information. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity carried out on your account.

section3.title: 3. Bookings and payments
section3.body: The prices shown include the service described on the booking page. Payment is processed by partner payment gateways (e.g. PIX). The booking is only confirmed after payment is approved, when you receive a confirmation code.

section4.title: 4. Cancellation and refund
section4.body: Tours: free cancellation up to 24 hours before the scheduled time. Transfers: free cancellation up to 72 hours before. After these deadlines, the amount may be withheld in full or in part. Cancellations due to weather or safety conditions, decided by the operator, entitle you to rescheduling or a full refund.

section5.title: 5. Community conduct
section5.body: In the comments and reviews on the "Discover the Village" tab, the following are not allowed: offensive, discriminatory or defamatory content; spam or unauthorized advertising; false information about establishments. Turiva may remove content and suspend accounts that violate these rules.

section6.title: 6. Responsibilities
section6.body: Turiva mediates the booking, but the execution of tours and transfers is the responsibility of the partner operators, who maintain the licenses and insurance required by law. Establishment recommendations on the "Discover the Village" tab are for informational purposes only and do not constitute a quality guarantee.

section7.title: 7. Changes
section7.body: These terms may be updated at any time. Relevant changes will be communicated in the app. Continued use of the platform after publication implies agreement with the current version.

section1.title: 1. Data we collect
section1.body1: We collect the data you provide during registration and use of the platform: name, email, phone/WhatsApp, ID document (when required for the booking), profile and cover photos, preferred language, and your booking details (dates, pickup locations, number of people).
section1.body2: With your authorization in the browser, we use your approximate location only to show nearby establishments and services. It is not stored on our servers.

section2.title: 2. What we use it for
section2.body: We use your data to: process bookings and payments; send confirmations and notices about your bookings (email/WhatsApp); operate social features (likes, comments and reviews display your name and profile photo); improve the platform; and comply with legal obligations.

section3.title: 3. Who we share it with
section3.body: We share what is necessary with: the operator/operator that will carry out your tour or transfer (name, contact, pickup point); the payment gateway (transaction data); and infrastructure providers (hosting and database). We do not sell your data to third parties.

section4.title: 4. Your rights (LGPD)
section4.body: Under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018), you may request at any time: access to your data, correction, account deletion, portability and information about data sharing. To exercise your rights, contact us by email

section5.title: 5. Storage and security
section5.body: Your data is stored on secure servers with restricted access and encryption in transit. We keep the data while your account is active or for the period required by law (e.g. tax records of bookings).

section6.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
section6.body: We use the browser's local storage to keep you logged in and remember preferences such as language. We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising.
